entries.gap: No scientifically justified pilot rule yet chooses the constant bets and predictor centers under a predeclared practical-width objective.
entries.impact: Efficiency and feasibility of R161; not validity conditional on a frozen admissible choice.
entries.counterexample: A predictor far from confirmatory observations makes the residual penalty large enough to exceed Hoeffding width.
entries.corrected_now: The theorem is conditional on frozen choices and explicitly rejects uniform superiority.
entries.unresolved_premise: Define and test a finite pilot-selection menu with a maximum-width/regret criterion and a DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE output.

entries.gap: General predictable varying bets do not preserve the unweighted target when conditional means differ.
entries.impact: Any future attempt to use fully adaptive bets in the R163 non-identical design can silently change the estimand.
entries.counterexample: Two unequal conditional means with two unequal positive bets have a weighted mean different from their arithmetic mean.
entries.corrected_now: R164 freezes one constant bet per component and records the target identity explicitly.
entries.unresolved_premise: A different adaptive-bet procedure would need an explicit unweighted-target theorem or must declare a weighted target.

entries.gap: Variance adaptation cannot remove rare-event protection; exact optimal finite-sample width for the declared decision is not characterized.
entries.impact: Sample size and practical resolution; prevents zero-width claims from zero sample variance.
entries.counterexample: At N=36,m=8 at least one no-spike component occurs with probability 0.746832681569142.
entries.corrected_now: Exact necessary event bound and N>=99 event-only threshold are recorded.
entries.unresolved_premise: No minimax or optimality theorem for the R161 decision family is supplied.

entries.gap: Arbitrary missingness leaves a support identification width and safety abort can make the full-data outcome undefined.
entries.impact: All-enrollee effects may remain uninformative or not well-posed despite narrower endpoint sampling intervals.
entries.corrected_now: Endpoint sampling error and identification width are separately typed; undefined outcomes are excluded.
entries.unresolved_premise: A narrower scientific target needs a defended missingness model or a different treatment-policy estimand.

entries.gap: No actual apparatus, participant independence audit, physical-role witness, phenomenal target bridge, B_min or F_O observation exists.
entries.impact: R164 cannot establish bodily mineness, familiar ownership, C1, complete organization or an exclusive owner.
entries.counterexample: A perfectly calibrated population interval can describe a statistic without belonging to any particular experience token.
entries.corrected_now: Population, finite view, actual token and experience-level interpretation remain separate in every contract and rule.
entries.unresolved_premise: Empirical implementation and independently justified experience-level bridge evidence.
